subject: VPN connectivity failure - unable to access remote payroll portal
description: Good morning, I am unable to connect to the VPN from my workstation at ServeWell - Velachery. When I attempt to launch the NetLink VPN client and enter my credentials, the connection fails with error code 0x80070005 (Access Denied). I have tried clearing the VPN cache, restarting the router (RTR-0086-01), and reinstalling the VPN client software, but the issue persists. This is blocking my access to the HR payroll portal where I need to verify my salary statement and review my shift hours for the month of April. I was told my salary deposit was processed, but the amount appears incorrect, and I cannot log in to check the detailed breakdown or raise a payroll correction request. The business impact is high as this is time-sensitive—our store payroll runs monthly and I need to submit any discrepancy reports by end of week. Please escalate this to the network team urgently so I can access my payroll records.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and categorized under VPN/Network. Initial assessment suggests potential router configuration issue. Advised user to check VPN client logs and confirm network connectivity to gateway server. Transferred to Network Operations team for further investigation.

Follow-up call made. User clarified that the core issue is inability to access HR payroll portal and verify salary deposit. Realized actual issue is HR/payroll-related, not network. Ticket misdirected—user needs to contact HR department for salary discrepancy investigation. VPN credentials verified as active in directory.

resolution_notes: Issue was user credentials related to HR portal access, not VPN/network infrastructure. VPN connectivity confirmed operational. User was redirected to HR department (ticket reassigned to INC-00250 under HR/Payroll category) to investigate salary discrepancy and shift hour reconciliation. Network asset RTR-0086-01 verified healthy.
